Right there you're fucking up by saying "he deserves better than me." No one can judge what another deserves, only we can decide that for ourselves. In my opinion at least. Your boyfriend I think needs to figure things out for himself, and I think you telling him why you're leaving may be a wake up call to him. Maybe he's depressed but hasn't been diagnosed? Something clearly happened to him, but if what you're telling me is true then you've done all you really can. 

As a rebuttal to your one point of "I don't want to be alone I don't think I can blah blah yadda yadda." Long story short I was in a relationship for a year and a half that ended horribly, and that experience made me want to do nothing but stay by myself. Now of course that scenario is different than yours, but being by yourself doesn't mean forever nor does it mean you're "alone" as my ex liked to call it. Embrace it, and focus on your goals, your hobbies, your interests. Maybe save some money, something. Stressing about relationships isn't healthy and I can tell you right now if you just jump into another one immediately after, you will regret it. I've been there. 

Maybe I'm wrong, I don't encourage you to try and prove me wrong, but people are a diamond dozen. You live and learn, people come and go. All of my exes I shared something special with, and even though our time has come and gone I still reflect on them and care about them just as much as I did the day I met them. Life will go on I can promise you that.

text:
She has to pay income tax on the value of the stock grant.

That is regardless of whether she sells the stock or not.  The stock grant is just salary,  paid in the form of stock rather than cash, so, she owes income tax on it.

If she does not sell the stock (or all of the stock), and it goes up in value, she will owe capital gains  tax on any gains when she sells it.  Long term capital gains tax (which is less than income tax) if she holds it for more than a year.  Short term capital gains tax (which is the same as income tax) if she holds it for less than a year.

Good luck.
label: ADVICE
